  • Method Details

    • putNewSample

      public void putNewSample(double sample, double weight, double simulationTime)
      updates the max, min, sum of weights with the new value.
      Parameters:
      sample - the value of the new sample
      weight - the weight of the new sample
      simulationTime - the simulation time for the new sample

    • initializeDistrubution

      public void initializeDistrubution(double intervalMin, double intervalMax, int intervals)
      Tells that this sample statistic should also populate distributions. This method must be called before samples are collected
      Parameters:
      intervalMin - the minimum value of samples to collect in intervals
      intervalMax - the maximum value of samples to collect in intervals
      intervals - the number of intervals to build
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this method is called after addSample
